passages.text: Thus the heavens and the earth were completed in all their vast array.
passages.sermon: God created the heavens and the earth.\r\nGod finished making everything in the heavens and the earth.\r\nGod completed all the hosts and all the things in them.
passages.original: וַיְכֻלּ֛וּ הַשָּׁמַ֥יִם וְהָאָ֖רֶץ וְכָל־ צְבָאָֽם׃

passages.text: And by the seventh day God had finished the work He had been doing; so on that day He rested from all His work.
passages.sermon:
God created the heavens and the earth.
God made everything in them.
God worked for six days.
God finished all His work by the seventh day.
God stopped working on the seventh day.
God rested from all the work He had done.
passages.original: וַיְכַ֤ל אֱלֹהִים֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י מְלַאכְתּ֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה וַיִּשְׁבֹּת֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י מִכָּל־ מְלַאכְתּ֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה׃

passages.text: Then God blessed the seventh day and sanctified it, because on that day He rested from all the work of creation that He had accomplished.
passages.sermon:
God created the heavens and the earth.
God finished His work of creation in six days.
God made everything in the world.
God blessed the seventh day.
God made the seventh day holy.
God rested on the seventh day.
God stopped all His work on that day.
God had completed all the work He planned to do.
passages.original: וַיְבָ֤רֶךְ אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־ י֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י וַיְקַדֵּ֖שׁ אֹת֑וֹ כִּ֣י ב֤וֹ שָׁבַת֙ מִכָּל־ מְלַאכְתּ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּרָ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃פ

passages.text: This is the account of the heavens and the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made them.
passages.sermon: The LORD God made the heavens and the earth.\r\nHe created them.\r\nThis is the account of their creation.
passages.original: אֵ֣לֶּה תוֹלְד֧וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֛יִם וְהָאָ֖רֶץ בְּהִבָּֽרְאָ֑ם בְּי֗וֹם עֲשׂ֛וֹת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶ֥רֶץ וְשָׁמָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Now no shrub of the field had yet appeared on the earth, nor had any plant of the field sprouted; for the LORD God had not yet sent rain upon the earth, and there was no man to cultivate the ground.
passages.sermon:
The LORD God had not yet sent rain on the earth.
No shrub of the field had appeared on the earth.
No plant of the field had sprouted.
There was no man to work the ground.
passages.original: וְכֹ֣ל׀ שִׂ֣יחַ הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה טֶ֚רֶם יִֽהְיֶ֣ה בָאָ֔רֶץ וְכָל־ עֵ֥שֶׂב הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה טֶ֣רֶם יִצְמָ֑ח כִּי֩ לֹ֨א הִמְטִ֜יר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ עַל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וְאָדָ֣ם אַ֔יִן לַֽעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־ הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃

passages.text: But springs welled up from the earth and watered the whole surface of the ground.
passages.sermon: Springs came up from the earth.\r\nThe springs watered the whole surface of the ground.
passages.original: וְאֵ֖ד יַֽעֲלֶ֣ה מִן־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וְהִשְׁקָ֖ה אֶֽת־ כָּל־ פְּנֵֽי־ הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃

passages.text: Then the LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground and breathed the breath of life into his nostrils, and the man became a living being.
passages.sermon:
The LORD God is the Creator.
The LORD God formed man.
He made man from the dust of the ground.
The LORD God breathed the breath of life into the man's nostrils.
The man became a living being.
passages.original: וַיִּיצֶר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶת־ הָֽאָדָ֗ם עָפָר֙ מִן־ הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה וַיִּפַּ֥ח בְּאַפָּ֖יו נִשְׁמַ֣ת חַיִּ֑ים וַֽיְהִ֥י הָֽאָדָ֖ם לְנֶ֥פֶשׁ חַיָּֽה׃

passages.text: And the LORD God planted a garden in Eden, in the east, where He placed the man He had formed.
passages.sermon:
The LORD God is the Creator.
The LORD God planted a garden.
The garden was in Eden.
Eden was in the east.
The LORD God formed a man.
The LORD God placed the man in the garden.
passages.original: וַיִּטַּ֞ע יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהִ֛ים גַּן־ בְעֵ֖דֶן מִקֶּ֑דֶם וַיָּ֣שֶׂם שָׁ֔ם אֶת־ הָֽאָדָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָצָֽר׃

passages.text: Out of the ground the LORD God gave growth to every tree that is pleasing to the eye and good for food. And in the middle of the garden were the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
passages.sermon:
The LORD God is the Creator.
The LORD God made every tree grow from the ground.
Each tree was beautiful to look at.
Each tree was good for food.
The tree of life stood in the middle of the garden.
The tree of the knowledge of good and evil also stood in the middle of the garden.
passages.original: וַיַּצְמַ֞ח יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ מִן־ הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה כָּל־ עֵ֛ץ נֶחְמָ֥ד לְמַרְאֶ֖ה וְט֣וֹב לְמַאֲכָ֑ל וְעֵ֤ץ הַֽחַיִּים֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַגָּ֔ן וְעֵ֕ץ הַדַּ֖עַת ט֥וֹב וָרָֽע׃

passages.text: Now a river flowed out of Eden to water the garden, and from there it branched into four headwaters: The name of the first river is Pishon; it winds through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold.
passages.sermon:
The LORD God created a garden in Eden.
A river flowed out from Eden.
This river watered the garden.
After leaving the garden, the river divided.
It became four headwaters.
The first river is named Pishon.
Pishon winds through the whole land of Havilah.
There is gold in Havilah.
passages.original: וְנָהָר֙ יֹצֵ֣א מֵעֵ֔דֶן לְהַשְׁק֖וֹת אֶת־ הַגָּ֑ן וּמִשָּׁם֙ יִפָּרֵ֔ד וְהָיָ֖ה לְאַרְבָּעָ֥ה רָאשִֽׁים׃ שֵׁ֥ם הָֽאֶחָ֖ד פִּישׁ֑וֹן ה֣וּא הַסֹּבֵ֗ב אֵ֚ת כָּל־ אֶ֣רֶץ הַֽחֲוִילָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁ֖ם הַזָּהָֽב׃

passages.text: And the gold of that land is pure, and bdellium and onyx are found there.
passages.sermon: The gold in that land is pure.\r\nBdellium is found there.\r\nOnyx is found there.
passages.original: וּֽזֲהַ֛ב הָאָ֥רֶץ הַהִ֖וא ט֑וֹב שָׁ֥ם הַבְּדֹ֖לַח וְאֶ֥בֶן הַשֹּֽׁהַם׃

passages.text: The name of the second river is Gihon; it winds through the whole land of Cush.
passages.sermon: The second river is named Gihon.\r\nGihon flows through the whole land of Cush.
passages.original: וְשֵֽׁם־ הַנָּהָ֥ר הַשֵּׁנִ֖י גִּיח֑וֹן ה֣וּא הַסּוֹבֵ֔ב אֵ֖ת כָּל־ אֶ֥רֶץ כּֽוּשׁ׃

passages.text: The name of the third river is Hiddekel; it runs along the east side of Assyria. And the fourth river is the Euphrates.
passages.sermon:
The third river is called Hiddekel.
Hiddekel flows along the east side of Assyria.
The fourth river is called the Euphrates.
passages.original: וְשֵׁ֨ם הַנָּהָ֤ר הַשְּׁלִישִׁי֙ חִדֶּ֔קֶל ה֥וּא הַֽהֹלֵ֖ךְ קִדְמַ֣ת אַשּׁ֑וּר וְהַנָּהָ֥ר הָֽרְבִיעִ֖י ה֥וּא פְרָֽת׃

passages.text: Then the LORD God took the man and placed him in the Garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.
passages.sermon:
The LORD God took the man.
The LORD God placed the man in the Garden of Eden.
The LORD God gave the man a task.
The man must work the garden.
The man must take care of the garden.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֛ח יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־ הָֽאָדָ֑ם וַיַּנִּחֵ֣הוּ בְגַן־ עֵ֔דֶן לְעָבְדָ֖הּ וּלְשָׁמְרָֽהּ׃

passages.text: And the LORD God commanded him, “You may eat freely from every tree of the garden, but you must not eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD God spoke to the man.
The LORD God gave the man a command.
The LORD God said, “You may eat from every tree in the garden.
You may eat freely from all the trees.
But you must not eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
If you eat from that tree, you will die on that day.”
passages.original: וַיְצַו֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים עַל־ הָֽאָדָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר מִכֹּ֥ל עֵֽץ־ הַגָּ֖ן אָכֹ֥ל תֹּאכֵֽל׃ וּמֵעֵ֗ץ הַדַּ֙עַת֙ ט֣וֹב וָרָ֔ע לֹ֥א תֹאכַ֖ל מִמֶּ֑נּוּ כִּ֗י בְּי֛וֹם אֲכָלְךָ֥ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ מ֥וֹת תָּמֽוּת׃

passages.text: The LORD God also said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make for him a suitable helper.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD God created the man.
The LORD God saw the man was alone.
The LORD God said, "It is not good for the man to be alone."
The LORD God decided to make a helper for the man.
The LORD God would make a helper who was suitable for the man.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים לֹא־ ט֛וֹב הֱי֥וֹת הָֽאָדָ֖ם לְבַדּ֑וֹ אֶֽעֱשֶׂהּ־ לּ֥וֹ עֵ֖זֶר כְּנֶגְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field and every bird of the air, and He brought them to the man to see what he would name each one. And whatever the man called each living creature, that was its name.
passages.sermon:
The LORD God made every animal of the field.
He made every bird of the sky.
He formed them all from the ground.
The LORD God brought these animals and birds to the man.
He wanted to see what the man would name each one.
The man gave a name to each living creature.
The name the man gave was its name.
passages.original: וַיִּצֶר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֜ים מִן־ הָֽאֲדָמָ֗ה כָּל־ חַיַּ֤ת הַשָּׂדֶה֙ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַיָּבֵא֙ אֶל־ הָ֣אָדָ֔ם לִרְא֖וֹת מַה־ יִּקְרָא־ ל֑וֹ וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִקְרָא־ ל֧וֹ הָֽאָדָ֛ם נֶ֥פֶשׁ חַיָּ֖ה ה֥וּא שְׁמֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The man gave names to all the livestock, to the birds of the air, and to every beast of the field. But for Adam no suitable helper was found.
passages.sermon:
Adam was the first man.
\r\nGod created Adam.
\r\nAdam gave names to all the livestock.
\r\nAdam gave names to the birds of the air.
\r\nAdam gave names to every beast of the field.
\r\nAdam did not find a suitable helper among them.
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א הָֽאָדָ֜ם שֵׁמ֗וֹת לְכָל־ הַבְּהֵמָה֙ וּלְע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וּלְכֹ֖ל חַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה וּלְאָדָ֕ם לֹֽא־ מָצָ֥א עֵ֖זֶר כְּנֶגְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: So the LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep, and while he slept, He took one of the man’s ribs and closed up the area with flesh.
passages.sermon:
The LORD God acted with power and wisdom.
The LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep.
The man slept deeply.
While the man slept, the LORD God took one of the man's ribs.
The LORD God closed up the place with flesh.
passages.original: וַיַּפֵּל֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֧ים׀ תַּרְדֵּמָ֛ה עַל־ הָאָדָ֖ם וַיִּישָׁ֑ן וַיִּקַּ֗ח אַחַת֙ מִצַּלְעֹתָ֔יו וַיִּסְגֹּ֥ר בָּשָׂ֖ר תַּחְתֶּֽנָּה׃

passages.text: And from the rib that the LORD God had taken from the man, He made a woman and brought her to him.
passages.sermon: The LORD God took a rib from the man.\r\nThe LORD God used the rib to make a woman.\r\nThe LORD God brought the woman to the man.
passages.original: וַיִּבֶן֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֧ים׀ אֶֽת־ הַצֵּלָ֛ע אֲשֶׁר־ לָקַ֥ח מִן־ הָֽאָדָ֖ם לְאִשָּׁ֑ה וַיְבִאֶ֖הָ אֶל־ הָֽאָדָֽם׃

passages.text: And the man said: “This is now bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh; she shall be called ‘woman,’ for out of man she was taken.”
passages.sermon:
The man spoke.
The man saw the woman God made from his rib.
He said, “This time, she is bone from my bones.
She is flesh from my flesh.
I will call her ‘woman.’
She was taken out of man.”
passages.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֮ הָֽאָדָם֒ זֹ֣את הַפַּ֗עַם עֶ֚צֶם מֵֽעֲצָמַ֔י וּבָשָׂ֖ר מִבְּשָׂרִ֑י לְזֹאת֙ יִקָּרֵ֣א אִשָּׁ֔ה כִּ֥י מֵאִ֖ישׁ לֻֽקֳחָה־ זֹּֽאת׃

passages.text: For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and they will become one flesh.
passages.sermon:
A man will leave his father.
A man will leave his mother.
He will join with his wife.
The man and his wife will become one flesh.
passages.original: עַל־ כֵּן֙ יַֽעֲזָב־ אִ֔ישׁ אֶת־ אָבִ֖יו וְאֶת־ אִמּ֑וֹ וְדָבַ֣ק בְּאִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וְהָי֖וּ לְבָשָׂ֥ר אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: And the man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.
passages.sermon:
The man and his wife were together.
They had no clothes.
They were naked.
They did not feel shame.
passages.original: וַיִּֽהְי֤וּ שְׁנֵיהֶם֙ עֲרוּמִּ֔ים הָֽאָדָ֖ם וְאִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וְלֹ֖א יִתְבֹּשָֽׁשׁוּ׃
